Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric game construction animation sheet, STAGE 2, frames A B C D of an eight-frame cyclic loop.
Supporting references: local canteen-1409 screenshot is MATERIAL/PAINTERLY/VIEW/LIGHT reference only, do not reproduce its building or background. construction-1408 screenshot is ghost-worker scale reference only. worker sheet only proportions; workers here must be pale blue-white spirits.
Generate a LARGE 2048 x 2048 transparent RGBA sprite sheet arranged EXACTLY 2 columns x 2 rows of FOUR equally sized 1024x1024 cells. No grid lines, labels, numbers, text, scene background or checkerboard painted into image. Each cell contains same complete isolated construction site at exactly same size and same fixed camera and coordinates. Orthographic isometric game view seen from southeast, two ground axes 30 degrees. Use consistent generous transparent margins; site footprint diamond corners in each cell at local (100,720),(490,510),(920,730),(520,940), foot local (512,940). All artwork fits x80..944,y100..944.
Subject: GENERIC OPEN CONSTRUCTION SITE for a Thai underworld punishment station. NO BUILDING silhouette: NO roof, NO wall, NO gable, NO spire, NO doorway, NO floor above ground. Low irregular thin sandstone-edged dirt work pad, wide and low, not an elevated temple plinth, reddish teak planks and sandstone block piles, tied ropes. A rustic teak derrick crane fixed at rear LEFT, simple triangular mast and slender boom pointing right. Several individual disconnected timber posts on stone sockets, roughly half erected, NO connected rectangular building frame. Subtle worn gold Thai carved bands on crane/poles only. Sparse low scaffolding. Warm golden upper-left light, nuanced painterly hand-painted fantasy game rendering, detailed worn red teak grain and sandy taupe stone, matching the canteen reference materials, not flat vector or pixel art. 4 tiny pale blue-white ghost workers in simple wraps, each about 12% of total site height, no giant faces.
Animation: EVERY frame is a newly drawn distinct action pose, same fixed site and stationary stone texture/crane mast/posts positions. Crane is hoisting ONE separate long teak post near center-right at a gentle 65-degree tilt, oscillating a little during hauling cycle, never changing stage progress. Left-front spirit hammers a stake, two spirits lean back hauling rope, rear spirit carries stones. Frame A hammer above head and hauling arms extended, no impact. Frame B hammer descending and pullers lean back, crane suspended post tilts +3 degrees. Frame C hammer contacts stake with small pale ochre dust puff and tiny gold sparks, pullers deepest lean. Frame D hammer rises halfway, dust breaks into small motes, crane load returns toward start. Small controlled changes, no camera movement, no whole-scene shift, no opacity animation. Keep pad stones/wood piles/mast/posts pixel-registered across all four panels. TRUE alpha, clean edges, no red/yellow fringe, no glow outline.
calls.disposition: rejected visual: crane ornament resembled chofa
